about: Every place the product takes a time it did not read from the database's clock. tests/test_clock_allowlist.py enumerates every database function with a date, time or interval argument and every place src/consentvault reads the process wall clock (a call to, or a default bound to, datetime.now, datetime.utcnow, time.time or date.today), and fails on any that is not listed here, and on any entry that no longer exists. Kinds: records = the time is written or shown as data and decides nothing; local = the time is measured and judged on the same process clock (a duration, a deadline this process set itself), or a protocol fixes the host clock (a signature a third party checks, a token we mint and verify ourselves); open = a decision on the host clock; no entry may be open (tests/test_clock_allowlist.py fails on one). A new site needs an entry, and a decision needs the database's clock, not an entry.
